failedCandidateEvidence.renderReview: The dark field fills most of the posterior flank and reaches the dorsal and ventral contours; it does not read as a sharply bounded three-apex axine.

cueComparison.reference: A straight-edged posterior triangle with dorsal and ventral apices near their fin origins and a caudal apex tapering along the peduncle to the caudal-fin base.
cueComparison.before: A U-threshold filled nearly the full posterior body depth, with only a weak dorsal multiplier.
cueComparison.afterSourceLogic: Independent dorsal and ventral bounds expand from a narrow caudal point to the two anterior apices; the existing sloped anterior edge is retained with reduced organic wander.

cueComparison.reference: Deep, laterally compressed trunk; steep convex predorsal profile; short peduncle; forked caudal.
cueComparison.before: The failed candidate preserves these broad outline cues, but the oversized axine visually obscures the posterior form.
cueComparison.afterSourceLogic: Control stations and fins remain unchanged; the bounded axine should expose the dorsal and ventral posterior body contours.

cueComparison.reference: Large round eye, short opercular region, small terminal mouth, orange-red dorsal, translucent paired fins and forked caudal.
cueComparison.before: The failed candidate broadly follows these cues; they were not named rejection causes.
cueComparison.afterSourceLogic: Head stations, eyes, mouth and fin geometry remain unchanged to avoid unrelated scope growth.

cueComparison.reference: FishBase states a compressed cross section; oblique spawning imagery supports narrow width only qualitatively.
cueComparison.before: The failed three-view is compatible with lateral compression, but no calibrated top reference exists.
cueComparison.afterSourceLogic: Half-width stations remain unchanged; no unsupported top-outline correction is introduced.

parityPrediction.fit: The two observed errors are linear in amplitude to within 0.002 degrees; E(A) is approximately 0.05994 times A.
parityPrediction.rationale: Amplitude 12 predicts only 0.7192 degrees and leaves little tolerance below the actual 0.75-degree gate. Amplitude 10 preserves a visible burst stroke while providing a safer source-only margin. Frequency or phase changes lack equally direct two-point evidence.

uncertainty: No verified true dorsal/top or sharp frontal original was found. Width and frontal head shape remain constrained only by the authoritative compressed classification plus qualitative oblique views.
pixelPolicy: No reference pixels were copied, sampled, traced or redistributed.
